documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Financial Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited presented its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth and high capacity utilization. Management announced a greenfield capacity addition in Odisha and proposed mergers involving Marvel Dyers and Processors and Sobhagia Sales for forward integration. Additionally, the company commissioned a 40.3 MW solar power plant to reduce long-term power costs. Sportking India Limited reported a strong start to FY27, driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement. Management highlighted successful commercial operations of their solar power project and ongoing progress on their 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management guides a long-term EBITDA margin of 15% after the Odisha plant comes online.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, and management is encouraged by the outlook for the second quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, management expects demand to remain supportive in coming quarters aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand for yarn export into India has come from China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is planned to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited along with manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex announced for the Odisha project is approximately INR975 crores to INR1000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic buying enabled the company to manage input costs and protect margins despite raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Despite some increases in raw material prices during this period, our strategic buying approach enabled us to effectively manage input costs and protect margins.

margins_costs.claim: The overall spread during the quarter was INR133 per kg compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The newly commissioned solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost savings from the solar project are expected to be around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: Margins from the Odisha plant are expected to be 300 to 400 basis points or more higher than old plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 32.4%.
EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was recorded at 18.8%.
Profit after tax margin for Q1 FY27 was 10.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit After Tax Margin 10.8% 5.8% +498 bps 5.1% +565 bps 4.8%

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization of all units is more than 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilisation of all units more than 96%

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

orders_capacity.claim: The first phase of production at the Odisha project is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for Unit I Spinning Unit is 66,480 spindles.
orders_capacity.quote: Unit I - Spinning Unit Acrylic/Blended Acrylic Polyester Yarn/ Blended Polyester Cotton yarn 66,480 Spindles

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production at the Odisha greenfield expansion is expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Odisha plant to reach about 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
